probe_exit_code_contract.0: all measured budgets green and no measurement failure
probe_exit_code_contract.1: catalog file missing / bad probe arguments
probe_exit_code_contract.2: budget breach (existing alarm semantics preserved). NOTE (F-I14A-01): because an unmeasured bundle is now always a breach, ANY invocation without --bundle-measurement exits 2 — this is a deliberate contract change that the D1/D3 signers must accept explicitly
probe_exit_code_contract.4: measurement failure (subprocess rc / business failure / timeout / spawn error) — never reported as success
